Class GameDataCombat

java.lang.Object
game.data.GameDataCombat
public class GameDataCombat extends Object
The game data with all methods for combat manipulation. It's separated from GameData.java for easier read All methods here are used when we initiate a combat.

  • Method Details

    • startCombat

      public static void startCombat(List<Enemy> monsters, GameData data)
      Starts a new combat sequence. Initializes enemies, hero resources, positions enemies on screen, applies passive effects and sets the first target.
      Parameters:
      monsters - list of enemies to fight
      data - global game data

    • heroAction

      public static void heroAction(GameData data)
      Handles the hero action when an item is used. Checks energy and mana requirements before applying the item effect. Ends the hero turn if no energy remains.
      Parameters:
      data - global game data

    • endTour

      public static void endTour(GameData data)
      Ends the hero's turn. Applies effects to enemies and hero, triggers enemy actions, checks hero death and reapplies passive effects. public method because we call it in GameDataClick when clicking the endbutton
      Parameters:
      data - global game data
